privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.draftNote: Draft. Details in [brackets] will be completed before launch.
privacy.collectBody: When you send a request or booking: your name, phone, email and address. Usage analytics without your IP address or device details. Saved providers are stored in your browser.
privacy.retentionBody: Request and booking data is kept while the service is arranged and for a reasonable period after; analytics are aggregated. You can delete your data at any time.
privacy.shareBody: Your contact details are shared only with the master matched to your request or booking. We do not sell your data.
privacy.rightsBody: Under UK GDPR you can access, correct, export or delete your data and object to processing. Contact [EMAIL].
privacy.deleteBody: Use “Delete my data” in your profile to remove requests, bookings and saved items. You can also download everything as a file.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.platformBody: SNG Services connects clients with independent masters. We are not a party to the deal between you and a master.
terms.responsibilityBody: The master is responsible for the service, its quality and price, and any required registration or insurance.
terms.cancellationsBody: You can cancel a request or booking before it is confirmed. After confirmation, arrange changes with the master directly.
terms.complaintsBody: If something goes wrong, contact [EMAIL] and we will help where we can.
